items.title: Tutor Perini (TPC) Joins Four Major S&P Indices And Gains Wider Investor Attention
items.summary: Tutor Perini (NYSE:TPC) has been added to the S&P 1000, S&P 600, S&P Composite 1500, and S&P 600 Industrials indices. items.summary: S&P Global is back in focus as fair value estimates edge higher, with one analyst model moving from about US$503.30 to around US$518.72 per share.
